title: Luxuriously Crunchy Syrian Milk Chocolate Bars
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Syria with these crunchy milk chocolate bars, featuring a perfect blend of sour and sweet elements, making for a truly flexitarian-friendly treat.

ingredients.name: sour candy pieces
ingredients.notes: such as sour gummies or sour chocolate chips

instructions: Line an 8-inch square baking dish with parchment paper, leaving some overhang for easy removal.
Melt the milk chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Stir in the honey and sea salt until well combined.
Fold in the sour candy pieces, crushed nuts, dried fruit, and puffed rice until they are evenly distributed throughout the chocolate.
Pour the chocolate mixture into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Refrigerate the mixture for at least 2 hours or until set.
Remove the bars from the refrigerator and use the overhanging parchment paper to lift them out of the baking dish.
Cut the bars into 12 equal pieces and serve chilled.
